text:
Anya: Quick sync — draft of rollout safety protocol for region slices. TL;DR: start with tiny canary (1% region), run smoke + perf checks for 15m, ramp with feature-flag gates, auto-fallback to baseline variant if thresholds breach.
Devon: Nice. Which metrics are we using as hard cutovers?
Priya: Suggest primary: request_error_rate (relative increase), p95 latency (absolute ms), and model-quality regression (sampling + rouge/embedding drift).
Jason: For SLAs we should map to service SLOs: error_rate delta > 0.5pp over baseline -> alert. p95 latency +30% or > 300ms -> alert.
Anya: Agreed. Proposal: canary window 15m, lookback compare to 1h baseline. If any hard alert fires -> immediate rollback. Soft alerts (trend but below threshold) -> pause + notify owners.
Priya: Need synthetic user flows hitting critical endpoints (chat generate, streaming, embeddings) during canary. I'll add synthetic jobs that run every 30s for the canary slice.
DeployBot: pipeline #deploy/region-slice-v2 started by Anya — canary -> 1% region. Logs: https://ci/reports/2753
Devon: What about tenant-owned risk? Some customers are latency sensitive. We should exclude enterprise tenants from early canary unless opted-in.
Anya: Good call — per-tenant gating. Default: public canary excludes high-priority tenants. We create opt-in flag for specific customers.
Jason: Rollback runbook (condensed): 1) Flip flag to baseline variant 2) Scale down new variant 3) Post-mortem stub + notify customers 4) Block re-ramp until owner sign-off. I can draft the full playbook.
Priya: Observability: dashboards per-slice + per-variant. Add alerting on 5m and 1m windows. Also add sampling endpoint for quality checks so product can eyeball outputs quickly.
Anya: Quick config snippet for flags (for ops):
```
flag: regional_slice_v2
canary: 1%
ramp: [10%, 50%, 100%]
canary_window_minutes: 15
metrics:
  - request_error_rate: {threshold_pct: 0.5, type: absolute}
  - p95_latency_ms: {threshold_ms: 300, type: absolute}
  - model_metric_delta: {threshold: 2.0, type: relative}
rollback: immediate
owner: @Anya, @Jason
```
Devon: Who's owning the A/B analysis for quality? Need defined sample size and evaluation queries.
Priya: I'll own quality sampling + small eval harness (100 samples/min during canary). We'll run both automated eval and quick manual review.
Anya: Action items: I will add this protocol to shiproom + create the feature flag with slices. Priya: create synthetic jobs & dashboards. Jason: full rollback runbook + contact list. Devon: confirm tenant exclusion list.
Jason: One more thing — add a delayed auto-fallback if infra capacity drops (fallback to lower-cost variant) so we don't OOM during regional spikes.
Anya: Cool — will add infra fallback as secondary policy. If no objections, I'll kick this off tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup:
Priya: :+1:
DeployBot: pipeline #deploy/region-slice-v2 succeeded for canary (1%). Monitoring for 15m now.
Anya: Thanks team — we'll reconvene if alerts fire or after 15m window for a quick bake check.
